subject: Quick ask: share a 1-2 line endorsement after NovaPlus pilot
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@novaplus.ai>, Trevor Collins <trevor@novaplus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: share a 1-2 line endorsement after NovaPlus pilot

Hi Asha / Trevor,

Thanks again for partnering with us on the 4-week inference pilot — the team at NovaPlus was great to work with. I wanted to share a very short recap of the outcomes we measured and make a small ask.

Key pilot highlights (sanitized):
- Average token latency reduced ~42% (p95 from 320ms -> 185ms)
- Per-inference cost decreased ~28% after batching and KV caching changes
- Sustained throughput improved 2.5x at target QPS with stable tail latencies
- Error/retry rate down from 0.9% to 0.2%

Attached: a one-pager with the telemetry snapshots and an anonymized telemetry export for your review.

Would you be open to: 1) a 1-2 sentence endorsement we can use in a case note (we can anonymize numbers if preferred), and 2) a quick 15-minute call this week to capture a quote on-record? Marissa (cc'd) will take notes and Ben will follow up on publishing permissions / redlines.

Suggested times (Pacific): Wed 5/26 10:00-10:30 or Thu 5/27 14:00-14:15 — if one of those works, I can calendar the slot.

If you'd rather provide a short line by email, something like: "Redwood helped us reduce inference latency by X% and lower unit cost, enabling Y" would be perfect. No pressure — we want whatever you're comfortable with.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com
[Attachment: novaplus-kpi-onepager.pdf (pdf, 850KB)]
[Attachment: pilot-telemetry.csv (csv, 120KB)]

From: Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@novaplus.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Trevor Collins <trevor@novaplus.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: share a 1-2 line endorsement after NovaPlus pilot

Kimberly — thanks and great to see the consolidated numbers. Appreciate you sending the one-pager.

We can definitely provide a short endorsement. Trevor and I want to run the two lines by our legal/comms team to make sure the phrasing on percentages is ok; if needed we can anonymize or round. Happy to do a 15-minute call to capture something on-record.

We can do Wed 5/26 at 10:00am PT (that works on our side). On the call, we'd like to confirm exact attribution and whether the brief will include a short customer quote and a 30s audio clip (optional).

Quick preference: please anonymize exact user counts in the public blurb (we're fine with performance %s).

Thanks — speaking for NovaPlus: this pilot materially reduced our latency and made burst traffic more predictable, which is already helping product experiments move faster. We'll formalize a 1-2 line endorsement on the call or by email if that's easier.

—Asha Mehta
